result.stdout:
Commands
  status [path]  where this repository stands, and the one command that
                 advances it. What bare 'delih' runs
  init [path]  wire the gate into a repository and PROVE it refuses:
               writes tools/gate-hook.ps1, merges .claude/settings.json,
               proposes rules.yml if there is none, then runs the hook it
               just installed and insists on exit 2. Nothing is overwritten
               --store <file.db>  also build the light index, so the
                                  file-to-file layer rules work (~20 s)
  bootstrap   create the database and the owner/runtime roles (run once, as admin)
  migrate     apply pending migrations as the schema owner
              --test  apply them to the test database instead
  doctor      verify the day-1 guarantees against the live database
  projects    list the projects and their repositories, by name
  create-project <name>       register a project to index into
  scan <path> --project <name>  index a repository, skipping unchanged files
              --force           re-extract every file: needed after this
                                tool is upgraded, since a file's hash
                                cannot see that the extractor changed
  find <name> --project <name>  look a symbol up in the index
              --limit <n>       default 50
  history <path> --project <name>  read git history into the index
  churn <file> --project <name>    how often a file changes, and with what
  health <path> --project <name>   what the index can say without a model
  semantic <path> --project <name> resolve references: dead code, cycles
  check <path>                     apply rules.yml to a repository.
                                   WITHOUT --project it needs no store,
                                   no server and no scan: the syntax
                                   rules (empty-catch, sync-over-async,
                                   import) are answered per file. Layer
               
[truncated]
